enum.name: COOP_SAMPLE_FLAGS
enum.description: Per-reading status bits set by the FC. The companion applies the gates.

entry.name: COOP_SAMPLE_VALID
entry.description: The driver reported a usable reading (sensor-specific status is also sent where it exists).

entry.name: COOP_SAMPLE_CLIPPED
entry.description: IMU: at least one accelerometer or gyro sample in the interval was clipped.

entry.name: COOP_SAMPLE_GAP
entry.description: IMU: samples were missing inside the interval (the increment is still contiguous in time).

entry.name: COOP_SAMPLE_POWER_VALID
entry.description: UWB: rx_power and first_path_power were read from the DW1000.

entry.name: COOP_PEER_CRITICAL
entry.description: Send in the critical mesh class (ahead of all telemetry). Set on every cooperative estimator message.

entry.name: COOP_PEER_ACK_REQUESTED
entry.description: Reserved: request a link-layer acknowledgement (unicast only; not used by the estimator, which has its own ACK).

enum.name: COOP_FIX_DOF
enum.description: Degrees of freedom of a COOP_GLOBAL_FIX. Valid combinations: POSITION|ATTITUDE, POSITION|YAW, POSITION.

entry.name: COOP_FIX_POSITION
entry.description: Body origin in the map (3 rows).

entry.name: COOP_FIX_ATTITUDE
entry.description: Full attitude (3 rows, body right tangent).

entry.name: COOP_FIX_YAW
entry.description: Heading about map up only (1 row); not combined with ATTITUDE.

enum.name: COOP_FIX_SOURCE
enum.description: Source of a COOP_GLOBAL_FIX (diagnostic; the estimator does not depend on it).

message.name: COOP_IMU_DELTA
message.description: FC to companion, 100 Hz. First stage of the IMU preintegration: raw (bias-uncorrected) increment over one sub-interval on a fixed grid aligned with the 100 ms knots, expressed in the sub-interval's start body frame. Consecutive messages must be contiguous (time_start_usec equals the previous end).
message.field: Rotation vector Log(Delta R) of the sub-interval, in body FLU axes (x forward, y left, z up, as the estimator; the FC converts from its FRD INS).
Delta v in the start frame, gravity not removed.
Delta p in the start frame, gravity not removed.

message.name: COOP_FLOW
message.description: FC to companion, per PMW3901 report (up to 100 Hz). Counts converted to angle with the FC's calibration.
message.field: Support end minus the width-weighted support midpoint.
Angular displacement in calibrated sensor axes.
Upper triangle of the 2x2 angle covariance (rad^2).

message.name: COOP_TOF
message.description: FC to companion, per VL53L1X range (up to 50 Hz).

message.name: COOP_BARO
message.description: FC to companion, per BMP388 pressure (up to 50 Hz). Raw pressure; the companion converts to altitude against its arming reference.

message.name: COOP_MAG
message.description: FC to companion, per MMC5983MA sample (up to 100 Hz). Calibrated field direction in the body FLU frame with its tangent covariance (in the deterministic basis of the direction, hardware_models.direction_basis).
message.field: Unit field direction, body FLU frame.
Upper triangle of the 2x2 tangent covariance (rad^2).
Field norm over the surveyed norm.

message.name: COOP_GLOBAL_FIX
message.description: FC to companion, per sparse global fix of this vehicle's body pose in the map, from any source (motion capture forwarded by AP_CoopBridge, a marker or onboard pose frontend). Already converted to the body origin and the ENU/FLU frames. Replaces COOP_CAMERA (docs/plans/p5_global_fix_plan.md).
message.field: Time the fix became available on the FC, minus capture.
Support end (exposure end) minus capture (0 for mocap).
Body (FLU) to map (ENU) rotation quaternion (w, x, y, z).
Upper triangle of the 6x6 covariance, order [rotation (body right tangent), position (map)]. With COOP_FIX_YAW, entry (2,2) is the yaw variance.
Degrees of freedom the fix constrains: POSITION|ATTITUDE (6), POSITION|YAW (4) or POSITION (3).
Where the fix came from (diagnostic only).

message.name: COOP_UWB
message.description: FC to companion, per DW1000 DS-TWR exchange this vehicle took part in, at both ends (the initiator learns the range from the responder's REPORT frame; required_changes.md, section 4).
message.field: Total receive power of the FINAL frame.
First-path power of the FINAL frame.

message.name: COOP_PEER
message.description: Cooperative estimator message (M1, M2, ACK, STATE; the P4 wire layout, scripts/coop/runtime/messages.py) in both directions: companion to FC to mesh, and mesh to FC to companion. Critical mesh class: the FC transmits it ahead of every telemetry stream. Messages longer than one fragment (M2 reset, about 1.1 kB) are split; the receiving companion reassembles by (sender system ID, msg_seq).
message.field: Per-sender message sequence; all fragments of one message share it.
Freshness budget copied into the SwarmMesh header (0 = none). Frames older than this are dropped by relays.
Destination system ID, 0 = broadcast. Deliberately not named target_system: ArduPilot's MAVLink router would otherwise forward broadcast COOP_PEER frames to every other link (USB, telemetry).
Fragment index (low nibble) and fragment count minus one (high nibble).
Message bytes (MAVLink2 trims trailing zeros on the wire).

message.name: COOP_LINK_STATUS
message.description: FC to companion, 1 Hz. Health of the cooperative path, for the stale-state policy and bench diagnostics.
message.field: COOP_PEER frames put on the mesh.
COOP_PEER frames received from the mesh and forwarded.
COOP_PEER frames dropped on the FC (queue full, broadcast refused, deadline expired).
COOP_PEER frames not forwarded to the companion (UART full).
MAVLink parse errors on the companion port.
Largest critical queue since the last report.
